blocks.text: Forward Deployed Engineer Salary Explorer
A filterable table and honest range estimator. Every figure is a reported range with its source, never asserted.
The FDE salary web is full of unverified numbers.

Every figure below is a reported range with its source named inline. We did not include a single number we could not trace back to a real filing or a named aggregator, and we left gaps where the public data was too thin, rather than invent a figure to fill them. Verify against the primary source before you rely on any of this.
Reported FDE compensation, by source
Filter by company tier or region. Every row names its exact source; click through to verify it yourself.

United States (other / national): 21 disclosed 2024 filings for the exact job title "Forward Deployed Engineer." This is real base-salary data companies are legally required to file, not a self-reported estimate, but it only covers H1B-sponsored hires and base salary, not total comp.
United States (other / national): Self-reported total comp (base + bonus + equity) for the "Forward Deployed Software Engineer" title. Directional, not audited.

United States (other / national): 429 self-reported entries. This total-pay range ($191K-$292K, incl. additional pay) is Glassdoor's own estimate, separate from its base-pay-only 25th-75th percentile band of $124,513 to $198,096. The reported median ($177,381) sits below this total-pay range's low end because it is Glassdoor's separately published average total pay figure, not a midpoint of this range -- another instance of the same source publishing two numbers that describe overlapping but not identical things.
New York City: Single average figure as published by Glassdoor for this location.

London, UK: This figure looks low for the role and the sample is small (59 entries). We are showing it exactly as Glassdoor publishes it, not smoothing it, because an oddly-low outlier from a real source is more honest than a plausible-looking number we made up. Verify against a live London posting before relying on it.

United States (other / national): This is ManasFlow's own live starting price to place a forward deployed engineer, nearshore rate, published on our pricing page. It is what a company pays for the placement, not a salary paid to an individual, so it is not directly comparable to the rows above.
Honest range estimator
Pick your inputs. You get a range positioned inside the sourced data above, with the method and source named, never a single confident-sounding number.
Reported range

Positioned within the reported range for United States (other / national) (base salary, h1b/lca disclosure (all levels, national)), partitioned by experience band. The range itself is sourced; the position within it is our estimate, not a separately verified per-level figure.
Where the public data runs out

Glassdoor shows a small sample (12 entries) with currency formatting that was unclear enough that we could not verify it cleanly against a second source. Rather than guess at a conversion, we left it out.
No aggregator returned a usable sample size for this exact job title in Singapore as of this writing.

These companies do not appear to have a separately aggregated "Forward Deployed Engineer" compensation entry on Levels.fyi or Glassdoor distinct from general Software Engineer or Member of Technical Staff titles. Several newly-published sites claim specific frontier-lab FDE figures with no visible source; we are not repeating those numbers here.
Why FDE comp varies this much

The gap between a $150,000 median H1B filing and a $295,000 reported total comp figure is not a contradiction. It is three real variables stacking on top of each other, plus a sourcing problem the rest of the search results have not solved.
Seniority
The role spans someone doing their first embedded deployment to someone running a seven-figure account. That is a wide band in any engineering discipline, not unique to FDE.
Company and scope

Palantir originated the model, embedding roughly 120 forward deployed engineers inside JPMorgan starting in 2009. Compensation at the role's originator with venture-scale backing is a different market than the same title at a startup, an agency, or a mid-market vendor.
The two-judgments premium

The role requires technical judgment (agent loops, tool use, evaluation-driven development) and commercial judgment (mapping a real workflow, earning trust, explaining outcomes to a non-technical stakeholder) in the same person. Engineers strong on both are rarer than engineers strong on either alone, and that scarcity is a real driver at the top of the range.
Where ManasFlow fits
